QuestInfo.0: Tthaya seemed like she was missing a few screws. Take your time, gather your patience, and talk to her again.
QuestInfo.1: Tthaya was barely useful, but you did find out that the tourist girl is named Ritaya and was going to return to town... until the legendary beast #bSnowFro the Fruitnificent#k appeared and attacked them! Tthaya and Ritaya ran, but she lost her in the trees.\nTthaya is sure that SnowFro kidnapped Ritaya. You'll need to clear a path to get her out safely. \nEliminate #b80 #o8144002# monsters and 80 #o8144003# monsters#k.

0.0: I found Ritaya! Then I lost her! Then I found her again, but then the giant monkey appeared and I lost her again! I mean, I ran away and Ritaya ran with me, but when I looked back, she was gone! And so was the giant monkey! #bSnowFro the Fruitnificent#k ATE HER! I KNOW HE DID!
0.1: You have to help her before #bSnowFro the Fruitnificent#k uses Ritaya as a toothpick!

yes.0: The giant monkey took her deeper into the forest. Search further in. It might help to clear out #b80 #o8144002# monsters and 80 #o8144003# monsters#k while you're at it.

no.0: But you were my only hope...

1.0: Bummer, I'm like so completely lost. One second, I was chasing SnowFro the Fruitnificent, and the next, here I am. Seriously, though, that's one BIG monkey. \r\n#L0##bTthaya and Mr. Yoo are worried sick about you. They sent me out here to find you.#l\n#k
1.1: Um, like, why? I'm totally fine. I just wanted a picture of the giant monkey, that's all.
